change_summary.expected_result: The fixed-upstream Agent P0 Client UI is served through the existing LibreChat API without changing API, MongoDB, CodeAPI, RAG, NGINX, Admin Panel, Office Converter, files, Skills, conversations, or model configuration.
functions: Deploy the immutable GitHub Actions Client artifact recorded in client/artifact.json
Provide one discoverable 智能助手 workspace with 推荐助手, 我的助手, 创建助手, and permission-checked edit navigation
Keep existing Agent marketplace search, categories, details, deep links, Skills, and admin controls
Keep current protected upload menu, login, usage/model market, search fallback, context safety, and generated-files assets in the composed Client
Capture exact pre-release Client mount, Compose, configuration, protected service, and Office Converter identities
Replace only /app/client/dist:ro and recreate only LibreChat-API with an automatic rollback on any failed post-apply check
limitations: The 7 planned Workflow Manifest templates and Runtime production execution are not part of this release
The CI ZIP is an external immutable input and must be downloaded and verified before deployment; it is not committed to Git
No billable model request is required or allowed for this UI release
USER/ADMIN persistence operations in browser acceptance use a temporary test Agent and must be deleted after verification
change_summary.reason: Complete the approved Agent platform P0 UI batch and make the previously validated Client artifact deployable through a repeatable, rollback-first production gate.
change_summary.risk: Client-only replacement can expose stale or incomplete assets, lose existing custom overlays, or accidentally recreate a protected service. The release locks the upstream and CI artifact hashes, verifies every protected asset, snapshots the active mount and all protected identities, changes one Compose bind mount, recreates only LibreChat-API, and rolls back on drift or failed smoke checks.

details.command: Run the versioned remote-rollback.sh with the timestamp-matched backup directory and runtime-preflight.json; restore compose.override.yaml, recreate only LibreChat-API, and verify the old Client hash plus every protected service identity.
details.restore_scope: The active pre-release /app/client/dist mount and exact Compose override; no Agent, Skill, file, conversation, MongoDB, CodeAPI, RAG, NGINX, Admin Panel, or Office Converter data is changed.

validation_plan.expected: The CI ZIP, Client tar, ten protected assets, deploy runner, rollback runner, and release governance all pass without secrets or non-API targets.
The public baseline, active Client mount, resource thresholds, API/dependency service identities, Office Converter identity, and rollback source pass with no application write.
Only LibreChat-API is recreated, the candidate index/assets are served, protected service identities remain unchanged, and a timestamped backup/result is recorded.

validation_plan.command: USER and ADMIN browser acceptance at 1440x900 and 390x844
validation_plan.expected: 智能助手 navigation, recommended/my/create/edit, permission-safe states, personal Skills discovery, existing marketplace/admin controls, and protected Client regressions pass without a billable model request.
